Post-start fade of cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and s4 clear, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Confidence: inferred.

TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum, requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0.
